content.title: About
content.content: Vodka and cola is a popular mixed drink made of vodka and cola in proportions to taste. The beverage offers a refreshing flavor, combining the neutral strength of vodka with the sweetness and carbonation of cola.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The “Vodka‑Cola” cocktail became widely known in the 1990s and turned into one of the best‑selling mixed drinks in bars.
There are many variations: sometimes lemon or lime juice, or a dash of bitters is added to enhance the taste.
In Russia and other CIS countries the drink is often colloquially called “Bloody Mary”, although the original Bloody Mary is made with tomato juice.
The combination of vodka and cola is believed to soften the harshness of the spirit thanks to the sweet, fizzy cola.

items.title: Moderate consumption
items.content: In small amounts the cocktail can promote relaxation and improve mood.

items.title: Quick energy boost
items.content: Sugar in cola rapidly raises blood glucose, providing a short‑term energy surge.

items.title: High sugar content
items.content: Cola contains a large amount of sugar, which can contribute to weight gain and increase the risk of diabetes.

items.title: Alcohol intoxication
items.content: Vodka is a strong spirit; excessive intake leads to alcohol poisoning and other health issues.

items.title: Interaction with medications
items.content: Alcohol can amplify the effects of certain medicines and reduce their efficacy.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Pour 30–50 ml of vodka into a glass, fill the rest with cola, and stir gently. Optionally garnish with a lemon or lime wedge.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store vodka in a cool, dark place with the bottle tightly sealed. Keep opened cola refrigerated to maintain carbonation.
